title: moranopteris blepharidea

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Moranopteris blepharidea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, fever reduction, and antimicrobial activities.
